title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Readers
description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It fronts the 466-page German R823 source-control reader and retains the English working corpus, the 473-page Spanish R823 reader, Interslavic Latin/Cyrillic readers, bounded Slavic work, and bounded CJK/Korean, Arabic/Persian, and Indonesian components.

French R823 reader: 02d_Noether_French_R823_Cumulative_WorkingTranslation_20260718.pdf is a 494-page cumulative French working translation. Its declared scope covers 81/81 R823 units: Papers 1-43, all 31 lecture-book sections, the Kapferer-Noether item, bibliography, notices, reviews, and terminal books. File 14 groups the exact 130-file TeX build closure, German authority, source/target manifests, unit evidence and parity, terminology ledger, build records, hardened gate scripts, final audit, and visual checks.

The archive replay independently hardened the locator parser, passed its adversarial self-test, then passed all 35 declared completion checks and reproduced the 494-page Poppler pixel binding. The direct French PDF is exposed for readers; the German source-control PDF remains the default preview.

Status caveat: these are substantial source-reconciled working editions and translations, not critical editions, native-language certificates, peer review, mathematical proof checking, or guarantees that every symbol and translation choice is error-free.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first public surface with German R823 source control; English, Spanish, and French cumulative working readers; Interslavic readers; and bounded CJK/Korean, Slavic, Arabic/Persian, and Indonesian components. Not a critical edition, native-language certification, peer review, or proof checking.
